turns.text: Hello. I am the Chairperson of the board for this mock UPSC Personality Test. Before we begin, would you prefer to conduct this interview in English or Hindi?
Theek hai, hum Hindi mein baat karenge. Sabse pehle, kya aap mujhe apna naam bata sakte hain?
Namaste Nakshatra. Aap kis shehar ya rajya se belong karte hain?
